definitions.explanation: The first sign of the Western zodiac, covering people born roughly March 21 to April 19. Also the constellation Aries. Used in horoscopes and casual talk about star signs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牡羊座|おひつじざ}です。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{星座|せいざ}→星座：06313_seiza⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{牡羊座|おひつじざ}らしい。
examples.english: Apparently his star sign is Aries.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{牡羊座|おひつじざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦{運|うん}→運：02143_un⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧そうだ。
examples.english: This week's horoscope says Aries has good luck with work.

notes:
The zodiac sign Aries, for people born from late March to mid-April. The {牡|お} prefix marks the male animal (ram).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a person born under Aries
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれ：01867_umare⟧: born an Aries
- {牡羊座|おひつじざ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{運勢|うんせい}→運勢：15761_unsei⟧: the Aries horoscope

USAGE:
Star signs are a common small-talk topic in Japan, appearing in magazine and morning-TV horoscope segments (⟦{星占|ほしうらな}い→星占い：18861_hoshiuranai⟧).
